protocol.five_folds: test fold k, validation fold (k+1)%5, other three train
protocol.mlp_selection: lowest validation MAE; earliest epoch breaks ties
protocol.equal_head_width: zero-pad all input groups to twice the full fused dimension after training-only missing flags/scaling
protocol.secondary_comparison: same input groups with fixed small MLP; standalone and demographic-only increment
protocol.testing_unit: one person, seed-averaged absolute error; no windows as independent observations
protocol.multiple_comparisons: Holm across six pretrained-model fusion increments separately for each of SDS, SBP, DBP; other comparisons exploratory
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 paired person resamples, percentile 95% intervals; fixed split uncertainty not fully represented
protocol.permutation: 100000 paired person sign flips, two-sided; overlapping training folds can induce dependent errors

cnn_protocol.loss: one standardized squared error per person after averaging that person's clip embeddings
cnn_protocol.features: same four-block SmallHRCNN convolutional backbone with fixed adaptive pooling, new 16D projection
cnn_protocol.input: all common observed clips, resampled to 64 Hz and independently z-scored; no synthetic padding
cnn_protocol.selection: validation person MAE; earliest epoch ties; no refit on validation people

inventory.observation: One continuous 120 s neutral raw BVP interval, 15 nonoverlapping 8 s clips; 2 s extra context only for conventional peak filtering

limitations: Self-reported SDS symptoms, not clinical depression diagnosis
Traditional PRV estimates have no ECG validation
Stimulus timing uses source metadata, not new annotations

inventory.observation: First 2.0 s of each of three separate 2.1 s fingertip clips; total 6.0 s, never joined for PRV

limitations: Finger auxiliary domain, not wrist blood pressure validation
One cuff label per person, no continuous ABP
Source clips shortened from 2.1 to 2.0 s for complete common model patches; not numerically interchangeable with old protocol
Traditional baseline includes independently recorded table HR
Pretraining overlap with source patients not certified
